caseName: Nooksack Tribe of Indians v. United States
caseNameFull: Nooksack Tribe of Indians v. United States
attorneys: Frederick W. Post for petitioner. Solicitor General Cox, Roger P. Marquis and Elizabeth Dudley for the United States.

opinions.text:
The motion to dispense with printing the petition for a writ of certiorari is granted. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Claims denied.

Reported below: - Ct. Cl. -.
